description: This file defines the AnalyticsService class, which provides methods for generating defect analytics, including Pareto analysis and trend aggregation, for a manufacturing defect management system.

classes.name: AnalyticsService
classes.description: A service class that computes dashboard aggregates such as Pareto analysis and defect trends from defect data stored in a database.

methods.name: dict pareto(self, start: str | None, end: str | None)
methods.description: Generates a Pareto analysis over defects, returning the total count and sorted defect types with percentages and cumulative percentages.

methods.name: dict trends( self, start: str | None, end: str | None, interval: str | None, production_line: str | None, part_number: str | None, defect_type_id: str | None, )
methods.description: Calculates defect counts over specified intervals (day, week, month) with optional filters for production line, part number, and defect type, returning data suitable for trend visualization.
